note: Single source of truth for TransformerPath products and the free-vs-paid feature matrix. Pricing pages derive from this table rather than inventing features page-by-page. Prices are commercial REFERENCE/TARGET prices unless marked APPROVED; do not silently change an approved live price — change it here once and rebuild.

free.name: Free
free.outcome: Read daily intel, browse manufacturers/projects/tenders/events, post an RFQ, use selected tools and learning.
free.positioning: The free network. Protects the Google to TransformerPath to recurring visitor flywheel.

learning.name: Learning
learning.outcome: Learn: full pathways, practice, progress, 3D learning, Test Bay, capstones, completion records.
learning.positioning: LEARN. A structured pathway covering transformer-design topics typically developed over several years of engineering practice.

professional.name: Professional
professional.outcome: Work: Learning plus professional engineering utility — costing workbench, specification builder, bid evaluation, DGA workspace, professional exports.
professional.positioning: LEARN plus WORK. Professional is Learning plus a real professional workspace, not faster support.

team.name: Team
team.outcome: A team on one plan with organization management, members, individual progress, assigned pathways and a shared workspace.
team.positioning: For engineering departments, manufacturers, utilities, EPCs, consultants and service organizations.

listed.name: Listed
listed.outcome: A factual public listing — company, country, researched categories, official website, sourced capability.
listed.neutrality: No endorsement. Listed is a census listing, not a recommendation.

verified.name: Verified Manufacturer
verified.outcome: Verified company contact, enhanced profile, logo/media, product info, brochure, contact CTA, RFQ response eligibility, basic analytics, website backlink where organically relevant.
verified.meaning: VERIFIED MANUFACTURER means the organization/contact/profile completed TransformerPath's defined verification process. It does NOT mean product certified, quality certified, approved supplier, or technically superior.
verified.neutrality: Verification is identity/contact verification, never a technical quality judgement.

supplier_pro.name: Supplier Pro
supplier_pro.outcome: Everything in Verified plus advanced analytics, commercial profile tools, RFQ workflow, market watchlists, Intel Pro entitlement, monthly performance report, promotional inventory, advanced opportunity alerts.
supplier_pro.neutrality: Promotional placement is explicitly FEATURED or SPONSORED. Supplier Pro never buys organic technical ranking.

intel_pro.name: Intel Pro
intel_pro.outcome: Advanced project/tender filters, award history, factory expansions, company timelines, saved searches, watchlists, alerts, country dashboards, historical archive, monthly brief, exports when ready.
intel_pro.neutrality: Intel Pro monetizes monitoring/filtering/history — never the factual headline itself. Factual Intel stays public; the paywall adds decision value.

intel_team.name: Intel Team
intel_team.outcome: Organization, members, shared watchlists, shared saved searches, team alerts, exports, shared reports.
intel_team.neutrality: Shared decision value, not a paywall over facts.

enterprise.name: Enterprise Intelligence
enterprise.outcome: Multi-user access, advanced exports, custom market monitoring, custom reports, research requests, bespoke briefings, company/project tracking.

featured_event.name: Featured Event
featured_event.outcome: Prominent, clearly-labelled placement, logo/banner, enhanced event page, registration CTA, sponsor/exhibitor links, analytics.
featured_event.neutrality: FEATURED is promotional placement, clearly labelled. It is not an editorial recommendation.

featured_exhibitor.name: Featured Exhibitor
featured_exhibitor.outcome: FEATURED label, logo, booth number, products, brochure, manufacturer profile, meeting CTA, event analytics.
featured_exhibitor.neutrality: FEATURED is promotional placement. It never implies an editorial recommendation.

hosted_webinar.name: Hosted Webinar
hosted_webinar.outcome: Event page, registration, promotion, hosting, recording where supported, post-event replay, sponsor identification. Attendee reporting subject to privacy/consent.
hosted_webinar.neutrality: No lead data where consent/privacy does not permit it.

sponsorship.name: Sponsorship
sponsorship.outcome: Daily Intel sponsor, event spotlight, category sponsor, market sponsor, newsletter sponsor, annual knowledge partner. Every paid placement is visibly SPONSORED or FEATURED.

premium_volume.name: Premium digital books
premium_volume.outcome: Digital reference volumes; cross-sell to the related Learn pathway.
